scope: Selected accepted windows only; cached private sources, no new downloads

K1.supported: Scoped identity/multiplicity/completeness and committed publication correctness under declared failure model
K1.unsupported: cross-system ACID, power-loss durability, multiwriter consensus

K2.supported: New matched E2R representation/query results; transparent inventory costs and preserved negative DNS reuse
K2.unsupported: matched batch-stream ranking, full four-workload comparative performance, horizontal scalability

K3.supported: Common preservation principles with distinct domain-specific completeness/multiplicity/uncertainty constraints
K3.unsupported: universal state machine, causal operator edits, authoritative DNS zone or complete BGP state
